resources.string: Receiving paused: %1$s. Open the app to review.
Receiver state cannot be confirmed: %1$s. No second receiver will be started.
Android ended the receiving session. The root receiver is being stopped; reopen the app to resume. This is not an unlimited background daemon.
The receiver owner changed or is still active. Refresh its status before resuming.
Receiving needs review. Open TailControl and confirm recovery there.
Some receiver identities changed or have not exited. No unrelated process was killed. Check the log and refresh.

The previous batch failed or was interrupted. A file may already have been written while its inbox entry remains. Check the receive directory, inbox and log first. Resuming can create another copy. No file will be deleted or deduplicated automatically. With the skip policy, a name conflict also pauses receiving until reviewed.
No matching legacy default-socket receive loops were found. One-shot receives, uploads, Ping and login tasks are not selected.

Stop the old or manually started module receive loops with these PIDs: %1$s? Their boot ID, start time, UID, executable and arguments will be checked again. Files will not be deleted. Uploads, Ping and login tasks are not selected.
Errors pause automatic receiving for review. Android 15+ limits background data-sync sessions and does not restore them automatically at boot.
Android 15+ does not allow this data-sync session to restart at boot. Open TailControl to start receiving.
